ucs.title: [LLM] Earth Lusca (Aquatic Panda) mshta→scripting→persistence chain post-exploit of public-facing app
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Earth Lusca / Aquatic Panda (CrowdStrike) / Charcoal Typhoon (Microsoft) tradecraft of staging Cobalt Strike or ShadowPad via mshta.exe-launched remote HTA, followed by PowerShell/cmd and a same-host scheduled-task or service install. Earth Lusca routinely chains T1218.005 → T1059.001/003 → T1053.005/T1543.003 after exploiting public-facing apps (Log4j, ProxyShell, Confluence) or spearphishing-link drops.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes values(Processes.process_id) as child_pids from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="mshta.exe" (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","schtasks.exe","sc.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")) (Processes.process=*http* OR Processes.process=*https* OR Processes.process=*-enc* OR Processes.process=*DownloadString* OR Processes.process=*IEX* OR Processes.process=*Invoke-Expression* OR Processes.process=*/create* OR Processes.process=*"sc create"* OR Processes.process=*WebClient* OR Processes.process=*FromBase64String*) NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","NT AUTHORITY*","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Earth Lusca / Aquatic Panda mshta → scripting → persistence chain
let WindowDays = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(WindowDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "mshta.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","schtasks.exe","sc.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","-enc","-EncodedCommand","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","/create","sc create","WebClient","FromBase64String")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Earth Lusca / Aquatic Panda mshta → scripting → persistence chain (Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688)
let WindowDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(WindowDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\mshta.exe"
| extend ChildBin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ChildBin in ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","schtasks.exe","sc.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any ("http://","https://","-enc","-EncodedCommand","DownloadString","IEX","Invoke-Expression","/create","sc create","WebClient","FromBase64String")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Earth Lusca mshta Spawning Scripting or Persistence Binary
id: 8c1d6f3a-7b22-4a8e-9d1f-0e5b6c0d8a01
status: experimental
description: Detects Earth Lusca (Aquatic Panda / Charcoal Typhoon / TAG-22) tradecraft of using mshta.exe to launch HTA droppers that spawn PowerShell/cmd and immediately deploy a scheduled task or service for persistence.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143/
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/a/earth-lusca-sophisticated-infrastructure-varied-tools-and-techniqu.html
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1053.005
  - attack.t1543.003
  - attack.g0143
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\mshta.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\schtasks.exe'
      - '\sc.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_intent:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - '-enc '
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - '/create'
      - 'sc create'
      - 'WebClient'
      - 'FromBase64String'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_intent and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate enterprise HTA-based deployment tooling (rare; baseline first)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @ParentImage:(*\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\Mshta.exe) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\schtasks.exe OR *\SCHTASKS.EXE OR *\sc.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\rundll32.exe) @CommandLine:(*http\:* OR *https\:* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *DownloadString* OR *IEX* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *"/create"* OR *"sc create"* OR *WebClient* OR *FromBase64String*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^mshta\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript|schtasks|sc|regsvr32|rundll32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(https?://|-EncodedCommand|-enc |DownloadString|IEX|Invoke-Expression|/create|sc create|WebClient|FromBase64String)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData], multival=true)])
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Earth Lusca is consistently documented (Trend Micro 2022, CISA, Microsoft Threat Intel) chaining mshta-launched HTAs to PowerShell/cmd that registers a scheduled task or service for Cobalt Strike / ShadowPad / Doraemon persistence after exploiting public-facing apps (Log4j, ProxyShell, GitLab CVE-2021-22205, Confluence CVE-2022-26134). The parent=mshta + scripting/persistence child + intent token

ucs.title: [LLM] Earth Lusca WinRAR password-protected staging of credential & document caches pre-exfil
ucs.description: Detects Earth Lusca's signature pre-exfiltration ritual — invoking rar.exe / WinRAR.exe with the -hp (header-encryption) flag to compress and password-protect harvested documents, browser credential stores (Login Data, Cookies, History) and LSASS dumps prior to outbound transfer. The combination of password-archive of credential-store paths is a Bronze University / TAG-22 hallmark seen across Trend Micro and Recorded Future reporting.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rar.exe","winrar.exe","Rar.exe","WinRAR.exe") OR Processes.original_file_name IN ("Rar.exe","WinRAR.exe")) (Processes.process="* a *" OR Processes.process="*-hp*" OR Processes.process="*-p*" OR Processes.process="*-m5*" OR Processes.process="*-r *") (Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*Cookies*" OR Processes.process="*\\Chrome\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*\\Edge\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*\\Mozilla\\Firefox*" OR Processes.process="*.kdbx*" OR Processes.process="*.ost*" OR Processes.process="*.pst*" OR Processes.process="*Desktop\\*" OR Processes.process="*Documents\\*" OR Processes.process="*Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process="*lsass*" OR Processes.process="*.dmp*") NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","NT AUTHORITY*","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Earth Lusca pre-exfil staging — WinRAR password-archive of credential / document caches
let WindowDays = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(WindowDays)
| where FileName in~ ("rar.exe","winrar.exe")
   or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName in~ ("Rar.exe","WinRAR.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (" a ","-hp","-p","-m5","-r ","-ep1","-v")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
     "Login Data","Cookies","\\Chrome\\User Data","\\Edge\\User Data",
     "\\Mozilla\\Firefox",".kdbx",".ost",".pst",
     "\\Desktop\\","\\Documents\\","\\Downloads\\",
     "lsass",".dmp","NTUSER.DAT","\\Notes\\")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("explorer.exe")  // analyst-driven manual WinRAR launches
   or InitiatingProcessParentFileName !in~ ("explorer.exe","userinit.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RarPath     = FolderPath,
          RarCmd      = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Earth Lusca WinRAR staging (Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688)
let WindowDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(WindowDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Bin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Bin in ("rar.exe","winrar.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (" a ","-hp"," -p","-m5"," -r ","-ep1"," -v")
| where CommandLine has_any (
     "Login Data","Cookies","\\Chrome\\User Data","\\Edge\\User Data",
     "\\Mozilla\\Firefox",".kdbx",".ost",".pst",
     "\\Desktop\\","\\Documents\\","\\Downloads\\",
     "lsass",".dmp","NTUSER.DAT")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName !endswith "\\explorer.exe"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Earth Lusca WinRAR Password-Archive of Credential and Document Stores
id: 1e9b4f72-3c19-4f8c-8a2c-7d5e2a1c9b02
status: experimental
description: Detects Earth Lusca (Aquatic Panda / Bronze University / TAG-22) pre-exfil staging of harvested credential stores and documents using rar.exe / WinRAR.exe with the -hp header-encryption flag against browser Login Data, Cookies, .kdbx, .pst, .ost, lsass dumps, and user profile document folders.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0143/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1560/001/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.collection
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.t1005
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1539
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.g0143
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_rar:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\rar.exe'
        - '\WinRAR.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'Rar.exe'
        - 'WinRAR.exe'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' a '
      - '-hp'
      - '-m5'
      - ' -r '
      - '-ep1'
  selection_target:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Login Data'
      - 'Cookies'
      - '\Chrome\User Data'
      - '\Edge\User Data'
      - '\Mozilla\Firefox'
      - '.kdbx'
      - '.ost'
      - '.pst'
      - '\Desktop\'
      - '\Documents\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - 'lsass'
      - '.dmp'
      - 'NTUSER.DAT'
  filter_interactive:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_rar and selection_args and selection_target and not filter_interactive and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - IT admins manually archiving user profiles during migration (rare with -hp and these paths combined)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @Image:(*\rar.exe OR *\Rar.exe OR *\RAR.EXE OR *\winrar.exe OR *\WinRAR.exe OR *\WINRAR.EXE) @CommandLine:(*" a "* OR *-hp* OR *-m5* OR *" -r "* OR *-ep1*) @CommandLine:(*"Login Data"* OR *Cookies* OR *"\Chrome\User Data"* OR *"\Edge\User Data"* OR *"\Mozilla\Firefox"* OR *.kdbx* OR *.ost* OR *.pst* OR *"\Desktop\"* OR *"\Documents\"* OR *"\Downloads\"* OR *lsass* OR *.dmp* OR *NTUSER.DAT*) -@ParentImage:(*\explorer.exe OR *\Explorer.exe) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(rar|winrar)\.exe$/i
| regex("(\\s a\\s|-hp|-m5|\\s-r\\s|-ep1)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| regex("(Login Data|Cookies|\\\\Chrome\\\\User Data|\\\\Edge\\\\User Data|\\\\Mozilla\\\\Firefox|\\.kdbx|\\.ost|\\.pst|\\\\Desktop\\\\|\\\\Documents\\\\|\\\\Downloads\\\\|lsass|\\.dmp|NTUSER\\.DAT)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT ParentBaseFileName=/^explorer\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(), collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData], multival=true)])
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Earth Lusca / Aquatic Panda is repeatedly documented (Trend Micro 'Earth Lusca' 2022, Recorded Future TAG-22, CrowdStrike) staging exfil through WinRAR with header encryption (-hp) before HTTPS exfil, often against browser Login Data / Cookies / .kdbx / .pst plus LSASS dumps from prior T1003.001 activity. The three-predicate AND (rar binary + archive+password switches + credential-store path token
